progression.narrative: The performance opens on Ek4 and dwells most on F in Phrase 1. Phrase 3 (1:41.9) introduces Fk, centred on F. Phrase 4 (2:07.8) introduces G, Gs, centred on G. Phrase 10 (4:42.9) introduces Bb, centred on Bb. Phrase 14 (5:43.2) introduces C, centred on F. The line peaks at Bb4 (476.7 Hz) at 4:44.0. It closes on C4, not the tonic (F4 → F4 → F4 → Ek4 → Dk4 → C4).
